_comment: EXAMPLE manifest. Copy to data/seed/canonical_personal_memories.json and fill in with YOUR OWN non-sensitive facts (identical shape/schema). /data/ is gitignored on purpose - never commit real profile data. scripts/seed_canonical_memories.py --seed-file defaults to the local copy in data/seed/ and is idempotent. The records below are deliberately synthetic placeholders to demonstrate the schema and keep tests hermetic.
